request.description: PlusPim supports only launch. It loads the program on launch even when it was started outside Zed.

program.description: MIPS assembly file, or a list of files, that PlusPim loads on launch. A relative path is resolved against cwd.

args.description: Extra command line arguments for a spawned PlusPim (e.g. ["--strict"]). Ignored when tcp_connection is set.

cwd.description: Absolute directory that a relative program is resolved against, and the working directory of a spawned PlusPim. Defaults to the worktree root.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop at the first instruction after the program is loaded.
